sam: Hey team, seeing ~20-30% tail-latency regression on Mistral-8x7B after the kernel-selector tweak for sliding-window RoPE scaling. Baseline (pre-tweak) was fine. Repro: lots of short prompts (10-50 tokens) followed by long continuations (~1k+). Anyone else hit this?

isha: ugh. can you paste the kernel selection log + a perf profile? also which quantized kernel are we picking (int8/4-bit)?

sam: pasted logs below — kernel_selector chose a different path for streaming windows vs full-attn. snippet:```
[2026-03-18 11:12:03] kernel_selector: model=mistral-8x7b seq=1024 batch=1 chosen=kv_reorder_v2 fallback=kv_gemm stream_pref=true latency=45.3ms prev=34.1ms
[2026-03-18 11:12:03] kv_cache: realloc at gen_step=512 new_ptr=0x7fffbf size=128MB thrash_count=3
[2026-03-18 11:12:04] memcpy: device->host 12.4ms (hot path)
```

matt: this smells like batching heuristics + seq_len variance. sliding-window workloads spike seq variance; our selector estimates based on max_len. when variance high it picks a kernel optimized for long static seq which hurts short-window streaming. try biasing selection towards streaming kernels when seq_variance>0.25 or use median_as_estimate.

zach: also check max_position_embeddings mismatch — I found earlier that if tokenizer max_pos != model config we end up reallocating KV caches at generation boundary which thrashes memcpy. are we setting max_pos=8192 anywhere? our model config defaults to 2048.

sam: I did see reallocs at ~512 tokens (sliding window stride). I patched selector to prefer the streaming kernel when seq_var>0.3 and tail dropped to ~8% but average CPU went up ~10%. still investigating RoPE scaling side-effects.

isha: note on RoPE: scaling factor change (we used 0.9 for 8x7b) shifts attention value distributions — that can degrade quantized kernels (per-head weight distribution matters). quick isolation: run the same run with float kernels (disable quantization path) — if perf returns to baseline it's a quantization interaction, not batching.

matt: profiling command I used:```bash
./perf_tool --model mistral-8x7b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --mode streaming --trace kernel_selector --out /tmp/m8_profile.log
# grep results
grep "chosen=" /tmp/m8_profile.log | sed -n '1,50p'
```
sample grepped lines:```
chosen=kv_reorder_v2 path_cost=0.63 est_latency=31.1ms measured=48.9ms memcpy_host=14.2ms
chosen=kv_stream_kernel path_cost=0.72 est_latency=38.0ms measured=35.2ms memcpy_host=3.1ms
```

zach: thanks — that memcpy delta is the tell. if stream kernel reduces host memcpy we avoid thrash. also confirm KV pointer lifecycle: we should not realloc until > current_alloc_size. add assert in cache allocator.

deploy-bot: deploy: kernel-selector v2 rolled back -> kernel-selector v1 (route: prod/inference) by @ci at 2026-03-18T12:32:00Z :white_check_mark:

sam: cool rollback — i'll run the float-vs-quant A/B and post numbers. will also check tokenizer/model max_pos alignment. cc @zach @isha :thumbsup:
